protocol.purpose: Describe raw event counts against a simple stationary click-allocation reference.
protocol.source: Existing Fix05 page-episode aggregates and unchanged cohorts; no new warehouse query or model fit.
protocol.population: Complete-case members of each fixed Fix05 arm, restricted to 1<=prior+future clicks<=200.
protocol.cap_reason: Predeclared computational scope for the low-total-count diagnostic; total clicks are conditioned on by the reference.
protocol.null: Independent Bernoulli clicks per impression with one common page CTR in the two windows.
protocol.conditioning: Both impression totals, the combined click total, and prior clicks>0.
protocol.reference: Future clicks X ~ Hypergeometric(M=I0+I1,n=C0+C1,N=I1), truncated to X<=C0+C1-1.
protocol.computation: Finite-support hypergeometric weights from log-ratio recurrence; batches of at most 4096 rows.
protocol.reporting: Observed signatures beside sum of conditional probabilities on exactly the same modeled subset.
protocol.prior_click_bands: Observed counts only. No reference expectation is reported by observed prior-click band.
protocol.not_forecast: Reference uses future impressions and clicks. It is outcome analysis, never a predictor or ranking baseline.
limitations: The common-CTR independent-click model may fail under temporal dependence, changing query mix, seasonality or heterogeneous exposure.
Complete-case retention must be ignorable under this conditional reference; outcome-dependent observation can invalidate it.
Other eligibility/arm membership is treated as fixed under the reference.
Total-click restriction uses future counts and does not redefine the main prediction population.
No false-positive fraction, equivalence, calibrated hypothesis test, confidence interval or causal attribution follows.
Arms overlap and monthly pages/clients repeat; do not pool them as independent evidence.
